title: Permission polling only stops on one granted status shape
reasoning: The UI treats a permission as granted when either status.granted is true or status.status is 'granted', but the onboarding watcher stops only when status.granted is true. If runPermissionProbe returns the status-only granted shape, the onboarding state can keep waitingPermissionId set and continue interval/focus rechecks until the two-minute timeout even though the permission is already granted by the rest of this feature's own status contract.
recommendation: Make recheckWatchedPermission use the same granted predicate as the slide, for example status?.granted === true || status?.status === 'granted', and centralize that predicate if possible.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests are included for this source group, and the package test script only shows that Jest exists, not that polling lifecycle/status-shape behavior is covered.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a hook-level test that starts a watched permission, has runPermissionProbe resolve to { status: 'granted' }, and asserts the interval is cleared and waitingPermissionId is reset.
minimumFixScope: Update the watcher granted check in useOnboardingPermissionActions.js and add focused coverage for both granted status shapes.
